combo_label: Halloween × Taylor Swift × The Wizard of Oz

entries.clue: Silent hope you might make on a candle, and what all four take to the great head
Braided cord at the heart of a taper, waiting for a match
Wicked enchantress with green skin who melts when a pail of water hits her
Glowing by small flames alone, with every switch in the hallway left off
Yellow-brick way the lost girl is told to follow, and to keep on following
Red-suited carrier of a pitchfork, tail ending in an arrow point
Leathery night fliers, cut from black card and taped up in windows
Career chapters, each given its own act in the stadium tour she ran from 2023
A long-running quarrel between stars; hers have filled years of headlines
Green gem that gives the glittering city at the end of the bricks its name
Devoted follower of hers, a nickname the fandom wears as a badge of honour
